messages:
ana: Quick question 13  we plan to surface a "pending rate" line on invoices after the RC-MAY-26 rollout for visibility. Any objections? :thinking:

jess: Prefer showing it as informational only (no immediate charge). reduces support churn. we'll need a support macro and small blurb on invoice PDF.

mike: agree. analytics: can we tag those lines so we can split MRR projections by "pending" vs "applied"?

sandeep: yes  we'll add invoice_line.metadata.price_version = "RC-MAY-26" and emit rw.pricing.pending.count metric. also adding header X-Redwood-Price-Version for request-level attribution.

rebecca: vendor note: Marketplace SKUs need explicit mapping. vendor-ops will supply mapping CSV but timeline is Tue EOD. We cannot backfill Marketplace discounts retroactively.

jess: operational detail: for annual prepay customers, if promo opt-in triggers credit we should cap credits to invoice totals and carry remainder as account balance. avoids negative invoices.

ana: legal: ensure the wording "pending rate" clarifies it's informational and not a bill. i'll loop in legal if needed.

billing-bot: Reminder: billing calendar lock 2026-05-01 22:00 UTC. Any price metadata after lock applies to next cycle.

mike: action items: 1) support macro + invoice blurb (jess)  Fri. 2) vendor SKU mapping (rebecca)  Tue EOD. 3) eng header + metric (sandeep)  PR Mon. 4) legal blurb if required (ana).

jess: drafting macro now, will post in #support-desk for review.

sandeep: will aim for PR Mon and include metric docs for analytics.

ana: thanks team. escalate if mapping or ledger flow hits issues; we'll delay vs causing customer confusion. :thumbsup:
